questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: You are going the wrong way on a one-way street. This creates a risk of head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Stay alert for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the chevron points. In this case, the road curves to the left. Multiple chevron signs may appear throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: The road ahead is now a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Deer cross the roadway in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to pass a truck safely. Drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers to be careful because wet road conditions may make the roadway slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells drivers that a lane is ending. Prepare to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left on a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You may complete the turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way traffic. Do not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic. Wait until the intersection is clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the road curves right and then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane will end soon. You need to merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards or conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals can be used instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward, it means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that a divided highway is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed limit for exiting a highway. For example, 30 mph is the maximum safe speed for that exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic pass before you enter the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that there is limited space above the roadway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead where another road joins from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal is used when riding in groups to tell other riders to follow you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers may use this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a divided highway is ahead where the road splits into two one-way directions. Stay on the right side.
